purpose: Compact MMseqs18 command template revision; SEARCH computed identity only, unchanged clustering and other commands
software_deviation: MMseqs18-8cc5c rather than paper-listed15.6f452; effective defaults retained in logs; v2 SEARCH mode3 overrides v1 identity-estimation default, clustering unchanged; v3 adds ordinary external training projection and explicitly versions mapping-outcome controls.
revision_reason: Before any biological model fit: replace privileged training-self projection with ordinary external-query projection after the preserved v2 candidate-control failure and prospectively fixed focal/complete-copy diagnostics. Version the missing-assignment control contract explicitly. No phenotype-dependent selection or threshold adjustment.
identity_semantics: Only the two SEARCH commands request --alignment-mode 3: aligned-residue sequence identity is computed for their --min-seq-id 0.4 criterion and downstream hit ranking, under unchanged seq-id/coverage defaults. Clustering retains its original --min-seq-id 0.4 score-based estimated-similarity parameter/default behavior; this is not an assertion of exact-identity clustering or exhaustive homology detection.

projection_symmetry.training_projection: Create an independent train_projection_db from the same normalized training.faa, then search it against train_db. No same-prefix training-self projection. Clustering still uses train_db only.
projection_symmetry.query_projection: Ordinary query_db against the same frozen train_db with identical SEARCH option vectors.
projection_symmetry.vocabulary_boundary: Fit from ordinary external training projections, including explicit missing-hit diagnostics; occurrence>1 training genome and occurrence-vector consolidation unchanged. Freeze after command6 before external query createdb command7.
projection_symmetry.control: Compare every copied protein under ordinary external training/query projection: count same assigned family, both unassigned and assignment discrepancies separately. Require zero assignment discrepancies, complete unique comparison coverage and exact feature-vector equality. Matched absence is not successful family identification. Report nonzero status separately; empty vocabulary is ready_for_fitting=false. This new v3 contract never relabels a v1/v2 failure.
projection_symmetry.legacy_artifact_names: self.tsv and best-self.json retain their filenames but now store ordinary external training projection, explicitly identified in the report.
projection_symmetry.unchanged: Source/target rosters, group splits, masks, labels, model settings, RFE rules, baselines, endpoints, decision thresholds and study interpretation.

v3_revision_reason: Before any biological model fit: replace privileged training-self projection with ordinary external-query projection after the preserved v2 candidate-control failure and prospectively fixed focal/complete-copy diagnostics. Version the missing-assignment control contract explicitly. No phenotype-dependent selection or threshold adjustment.
